name: Mega Nirman & Industries Limited
about: Mega Nirman & Industries Limited engages in acquiring and dealing in precious metals and stones, and jewelries in India. It also buys, sells, deals, wholesales, and retails precious metals and stones, and jewelries, as well as articles made of precious metals and stones articles of virtue and objects of art. The company was formerly known as Daphene investment and Properties Limited. Mega Nirman & Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in New Delhi, India.
